name: test-support-test-of-dead-code
description: Test-support code is no target symbol when a test of dead code is judged. A test that calls a test-support function and a production function only it calls is reported as a test of dead code, in that function's component, and so is a test-support function that calls another test-support function and a production function only it calls. A test that calls only test-support code is not reported, the default minimum confidence withholds what is reported about the test-support function both callers share, and each production function that only test code calls is reported as test-only use.
